usage: A popular leafy green vegetable in Cantonese cuisine
Often blanched or stir-fried and served with simple seasoning
Commonly paired with garlic or oyster sauce
Frequently ordered in restaurants and cooked at home
Appears in everyday food, cooking, and shopping conversations
